title: PROPOSED — Canonical EvidenceRepresentation vocabulary
description: One request/transport vocabulary shared by the internal model, HTTP/OpenAPI, MCP JSON Schema, structuredContent, canonical JSON fallback and capability discovery.

x-mnemo-compatibility.existing_values: No existing value is renamed or reinterpreted.
x-mnemo-compatibility.multilingual_text: The missing MCP schema value is added additively. A runtime may advertise it as callable only when the derived V2_EXPOSED predicate is true.
x-mnemo-compatibility.unknown_values: Rejected by every strict transport contract.
x-mnemo-compatibility.title_metadata: Selectable metadata representation only; never valid as a substitute for reranker semantic_text.
x-mnemo-compatibility.namespace: This is the public retrieval representation vocabulary. RepresentationObservationV1 representation_type is a separate encoding/derivation-state vocabulary and maps to multilingual_text only through a governed TextRepresentationReferenceV1.
